create.name: Deb Poole
create.bio:
Deb Poole (who also writes as Deb Lauren Poole) is a meditation and breathwork facilitator whose work is built around rest as a spiritual practice. She trained in Yoga Nidra with Santosha in 2017 and later qualified as a SHERPA breath and cold-water instructor, and in 2022 she opened The Plunge Houz, a community space for breathing practice, meditation and cold immersion. Her guided meditations on Insight Timer have been played more than 200,000 times.

She now teaches through Wild Rest Alchemy, her own practice. Its best-known offering is the Surround Sound Journey, a guided meditation heard on headphones that weaves music, story and imagery together, which she leads for events, retreats and private groups; she also hosts Sacred Suppers, small gatherings that combine a shared meal with ritual and music. Alongside this she has spent around seven years studying Human Design, and she writes long, personal chart readings called Living Maps. Her Attunement Sessions, a six-part one-to-one series, pair a modest fee with a piece of service work agreed with each person, on the view that looking outward is part of finding your footing.

courses.title: The Wild Rest Living Map (Human Design Reading)
courses.description: A long written Human Design reading prepared for one person, combining analysis of their chart with reflection prompts and practical suggestions for the stage of life they describe when ordering. Payment plans are offered.

courses.title: Attunement Sessions
courses.description: A series of six one-to-one sessions for people who feel out of step with their own lives, drawing on Human Design, nervous-system awareness and time in nature. Part of the exchange is a piece of service work chosen together.
courses.price: $65 USD per session or $390 USD for six, plus agreed service
